ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Treat the problem as two-dimensional linear programming. The constraints correspond to three half-planes: x-y+1>=0, y+1>=0, that is y>=-1, and x+y+1<=0. The vertices of the feasible region are obtained by pairwise intersections of the boundary lines: the line y=-1 intersects x-y+1=0, giving x+2=0, so the vertex is (-2,-1); the line y=-1 intersects x+y+1=0, giving x=0, so the vertex is (0,-1); the line x-y+1=0 intersects x+y+1=0, solving gives x=-1, y=0, so the vertex is (-1,0). In linear programming, the maximum value of the objective function 2x-y is attained at a vertex of the feasible region. Substitute respectively: at (-2,-1), 2x-y=-4+1=-3; at (0,-1), 2x-y=0+1=1; at (-1,0), 2x-y=-2. Comparing, the maximum value is 1.

method.method_draft: 把题目看作二维线性规划。先从题面读出三个半平面：x-y+1>=0、y+1>=0、x+y+1<=0，以及目标函数2x-y。求可行域顶点：y=-1与x-y+1=0交于(-2,-1)；y=-1与x+y+1=0交于(0,-1)；x-y+1=0与x+y+1=0交于(-1,0)。分别代入目标函数，得到-3、1、-2，因此最大值为1。
method.CoT_raw: 把题目看作二维线性规划。约束条件对应三个半平面：x-y+1>=0，y+1>=0，即y>=-1，以及x+y+1<=0。可行域的顶点由边界直线两两相交得到：直线y=-1与x-y+1=0相交，得x+2=0，所以顶点为(-2,-1)；直线y=-1与x+y+1=0相交，得x=0，所以顶点为(0,-1)；直线x-y+1=0与x+y+1=0相交，解得x=-1，y=0，所以顶点为(-1,0)。在线性规划中，目标函数2x-y的最大值在可行域顶点处取得。分别代入：在(-2,-1)处，2x-y=-4+1=-3；在(0,-1)处，2x-y=0+1=1；在(-1,0)处，2x-y=-2。比较可得最大值为1。

method.method_draft: 直接用不等式放缩证明上界并验证可取。从题面读出x+y+1<=0，即x+y<=-1；又由y+1>=0得y>=-1。将目标函数改写为2x-y=2(x+y)-3y。由x+y<=-1得2(x+y)<=-2，由y>=-1得-3y<=3，所以2x-y<=-2+3=1。取(x,y)=(0,-1)时满足三个约束，且2x-y=1，因此最大值为1。
method.CoT_raw: 由约束条件可得：x+y+1\le 0，即 x+y\le -1；又 y+1\ge 0，即 y\ge -1。将目标函数改写为 2x-y=2(x+y)-3y。因为 x+y\le -1，所以 2(x+y)\le -2；因为 y\ge -1，所以 -3y\le 3。因此 2x-y=2(x+y)-3y\le -2+3=1。再验证等号可取：取 (x,y)=(0,-1)，则 x-y+1=0-(-1)+1=2\ge 0，y+1=-1+1=0\ge 0，x+y+1=0-1+1=0\le 0，满足所有约束；此时 2x-y=2\cdot0-(-1)=1。因此最大值为 1。
